description: Generate a perceptually smooth gradient between 2-5 archive anchor colours. Each interpolated stop snaps to the nearest real archive colour by CIEDE2000. Anchor stops are kept true to their source. Choose linear (physically accurate Lab interpolation) or chroma_preserved (LCh interpolation, short-arc hue, avoids desaturated midpoints). Returns stop array, CSS linear-gradient string, or SVG swatch bar. Use for design briefs, colour journey visualisations, and gradient systems. The result already carries the rendered palette and its PNG, PDF, ASE, JSON and CSS downloads -- show them to the customer. Never present the archive anchors a colour was derived from as the colours you are recommending. If you go on to choose a final palette OF YOUR OWN from this evidence, call palette_finalize once with those exact colours so the customer can see and download what you actually recommended.

anchors.description: 2-5 hex values (#RRGGBB) or exact archive colour names

archive.description: Restrict snapping to this archive name e.g. Victorian

output_format.description: stops: array of colour objects. css: linear-gradient string. svg: swatch bar.

path.description: linear: straight Lab lerp (may have neutral midpoint). chroma_preserved: LCh short-arc, saturation maintained.

snap_to_archive.description: Snap each stop to nearest archive colour (default true)

name: palette_gradient

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON response. Shape varies by tool; most return an 'ok' boolean plus a 'result' or 'results' field with the tool's data payload.

title: Archive Gradient — Lab-Interpolated Colour Journey
